correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md and check.py. Injective tensor H⊗G is exactly N(u,v)=max(||u||,||v||,||u+v||); the three evaluation vectors (u,v,-u-v) permit every permutation by common linear isometries. The chosen positive convex quadratic minorant E=a(||u||²+||v||²)+c||u+v||², 2a+c=1, has P^-1=[[B,-1/2],[-1/2,B]], B=1+sqrt(3)/2. For unequal active indices, the Hilbert map L(x,y)=(u+s,v-t) has squared norm D=2+sqrt(3) relative to E, while equal indices obey parallelogram, yielding C_NJ<=B. The orthonormal h,k witness in RESULT attains equality. Canonical projective tensor dual to L(H,G*) and the isometry (u,v)->(u,-v), plus C_NJ(X)=C_NJ(X*), transfers the bound and attainment to projective, also for arbitrary Hilbert dimension. Independently computed SymPy P inverse exactly, B≈1.8660254038 and verified scalar equalities; finite 9000 checks in source script are supplementary, not substitutes for the all-H proof.
